 World Series Game 1 warmup: Simpson hitting 3rd, Williamson at 2B
 Plus, reliever Garrett Cleavinger is added to the Rays 26-man roster. And, the American Family Field roof will be closed.     .   With the Rays facing hard-throwing Brewers right-hander Jacob Misiorowski, Chandler Simpson, pictured, is hitting third and Ben Williamson is starting at second base ahead of Richie Palacios. [ JEFFEREE WOO | Times ] Marc Topkin is a sports reporter covering the Tampa Bay Rays. Reach him at mtopkin@tampabay.com.
